title: session.change — Request Mode Switch
description: Client requests a pipeline mode change (chat/translate/transcribe/omni) or a session config change via the control pseudo-mode mode=config. Server replies with session.changed to confirm.

mode.description: Target pipeline mode. 'transcribe' = ASR-only live transcription (no LLM, no TTS; pipeline only). 'omni' = full-modality realtime model (single stream: audio+image in, text+audio out; requires server omni provider). 'config' is a control pseudo-mode: it only applies the fields in this payload (currently avdetector) and does not change the active pipeline mode.

my_language.description: User's native language code (e.g. 'zh', 'en', 'ja'). Required when mode=translate.

local_language.description: Local environment language code (e.g. 'ja', 'fr'). Required when mode=translate.

usecase.description: Translation usecase. Only meaningful when mode=translate. 'dialogue' (default) = turn-based LLM translation; 'lecture' = streaming simultaneous interpretation (LiveTranslate).

avdetector.description: Required when mode=config. Per-session AVDetector switch to apply; ignored for other modes. Explicit null is invalid; the server rejects it as SESSION_CONFIG_FAILED (1011).
